seo.title: The Talisman | Restaurant, Bar & Garden in Karen, Nairobi
seo.description: The Talisman on Ngong Road, Karen: a garden restaurant and bar since 2003. Eclectic cuisine from our own farm, cocktails, local art and live music in Nairobi.

hero_image.alt: Thatched gazebos in the Talisman garden by day

top.intro: An old house in Karen turned into one of Kenya’s most loved restaurants. House-cured salmon, a garden farm, and thirty years of collected art.

image.alt: A guest laughing over cocktails at Talisman

about.heading:
A home for
*every table.*
about.text: Since 2003, friends, families and neighbours from every corner of the world have gathered here. Stained glass, collected art and lanterns as the light goes.
